final_assessment: rc07-artifact-lint archived with the review-system gate COMPUTED PASSED — the first rc-stage to reach a passed system gate rather than archiving through an override, and it took a deliberate over-budget fourth independent pass to get there. The change shipped `orbit validate --sources`: a `src:` marker delimits a span in living prose, the registry names an engine-computed source, and the check asks only whether the span CONTAINS that string. Four sources are dogfooded in CLAUDE.md. The cycle's own record is the more useful artifact: five independent passes (three external GPT-5 Codex, one fresh, one in-context) produced 38 findings, all walked to zero, none re-opened. The marker FORMAT changed mid-cycle — the closer gained its name so the name grammar could make prose inert — which deleted an inline-code scanner in which four separate reviewers had each found a different defect. Two lessons were institutionalised as program open questions rather than left in the trail: Q-crc-17, that a walk record with hand-retyped finding titles matched ZERO findings by the gate's key while declaring ten resolved, and the completeness lesson the final external pass named — that inferring state from selected finding kinds leaves a new scope uncovered every round, which is why completeness is now CARRIED. 2202 tests green; validate --all --strict clean across 25 items; fingerprints verified; marker sweep zero.
